source: Anastasia Kireeva, Randomstrasse 101, Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdos-Renyi graph (problems 36-38), posted 2026-06-05, first displayed Open Problem 35

method_outcomes.B5: Exact simultaneous Kato gauge freezes every ordinary algebraic source layer and source-number operator. In that gauge the zero-field pairwise Ising exponential degree tilt has no effect through second order; first tilt-sensitive source-degree leakage is the cubic three-neighbor-star term with degree gap 2 and cosh(2s) amplification.
method_outcomes.B18: Recast tilted transport as stability of the product number Hamiltonian under a connected quasi-local perturbation. Proved rooted-cluster coercivity: if C_hat_s=N_0+sum_X B_X with B_X local, self-adjoint, constant-annihilating and sup_i sum_{X contains i} ||B_X||=epsilon<1, then (1-epsilon)N_0 <= C_hat_s <= (1+epsilon)N_0.
method_outcomes.B30: Localized the Kato-gauged expansion by interaction scale. One-edge first variation has rooted norm <= |alpha| J_row. Mixed second derivatives for vertex-disjoint edges vanish exactly in a factorizing Kato gauge, so second order is supported only on connected wedges and remains degree-preserving; the first degree-changing scale is cubic three-star leakage. The unresolved transport step is the all-scale connected rooted majorant.
